mapper.insert: insert into cmr1010 (CR_ACPTNO,CR_SERNO,CR_SYSCD,CR_SYSGB,CR_JOBCD, CR_STATUS,CR_QRYCD,CR_RSRCCD,CR_DSNCD,CR_DSNCD2,CR_RSRCNAME, CR_RSRCNAM2,CR_SRCCHG,CR_SRCCMP,CR_PRIORITY,CR_APLYDATE, CR_VERSION,CR_BEFVER,CR_CONFNO,CR_EDITOR,CR_BASENO,CR_BASEITEM, CR_ITEMID,CR_EDITCON,CR_ANALYN,CR_PGMTYPE) (select a.cr_acptno, (select max(cr_serno) from cmr1010 where cr_acptno=#{CR_ACPTNO})+rownum, a.cr_syscd,a.CR_SYSGB,b.CR_JOBCD,'0',b.CR_QRYCD,b.CR_RSRCCD, b.CR_DSNCD,b.CR_DSNCD2,b.CR_RSRCNAME,b.CR_RSRCNAM2,b.CR_SRCCHG, 'Y',b.CR_PRIORITY,a.CR_APLYDATE,b.CR_VERSION,b.CR_BEFVER, a.CR_CONFNO,a.CR_EDITOR,a.CR_BASENO,a.CR_BASEITEM,b.CR_ITEMID, a.CR_EDITCON,a.CR_ANALYN,a.CR_PGMTYPE from cmr1010 a,cmr1010 b where a.cr_acptno=#{CR_ACPTNO} and a.cr_itemid=a.cr_baseitem and b.cr_acptno=a.cr_confno and a.cr_itemid=b.cr_baseitem and a.cr_itemid!=b.cr_itemid and a.cr_status!='3')
mapper.select: select b.cm_samename,b.cm_samersrc,b.cm_basedir, b.cm_samedir,b.cm_basename,b.cm_cmdyn,a.cm_info, c.cm_codename from cmm0036 a,cmm0037 b, cmm0020 c where b.cm_syscd = #{syscd} and b.cm_rsrccd = #{rsrccd} and b.cm_factcd='04' and b.cm_syscd=a.cm_syscd and b.cm_samersrc=a.cm_rsrccd and c.cm_macode = 'JAWON' and c.cm_micode = b.cm_samersrc
